topics.definition: Deep Learning is a subset of Machine Learning that uses neural networks with multiple layers to learn complex patterns from data.
tips: Requires large datasets and computing power.

topics.definition: ANNs are computing models inspired by the human brain, made up of interconnected neurons.
tips: ANN is the foundation of deep learning.

topics.definition: The input layer receives data and passes it to the network.
Hidden layers extract important features from input data.
tips: More layers can learn more complex patterns.

topics.definition: The output layer produces the final prediction.
Activation functions help neural networks learn non-linear relationships.
tips: ReLU is widely used in hidden layers.

topics.definition: Models learn by adjusting weights using backpropagation and optimization algorithms.
Deep Learning is used in computer vision, speech recognition, NLP and autonomous vehicles.
tips: Used in many modern AI systems.

topics.definition: Use quality data, monitor overfitting and validate models before deployment.
